name: Yuzawa Maiko
source:
[url=/c19345]Shion's[/url] classmate and the leader of the group that bullies her. She is wealthy due to her father being the branch manager of a major bank and her mother PTA's president. Maiko herself is a refined girl with good grades and a promising future.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=804105]Getchu[/url]]
